Equal serialized handler values from another VM can have different prototypes; prototype inequality is not a model or consumer behavior failure. The existing current.generations helper already uses serialized hashing for these same fields.

review.tests: Independently reran model-comparison.test.js: 4 passed, 0 failed, including actual frozen-handler serialization/replay.
review.operational_change: Resume with 48 bounded workers instead of 32. Model sampling, token limits, prompts, cases, validators and judge settings are unchanged.
